title: decision-response
description: A person's answer to one decision request. The reference queue keeps it at <state root>/knowledge/decisions/inbox/<request id>.json, written once. `responder` names a person; AI and automation names are refused. This is not authentication. An answer applies to its task only unless `reuse` says otherwise, and even then it is never a rule by itself: reuse beyond the task goes through the approval flow as a candidate.

reuse.description: Where the answer may be used again, and until when. task (the default) is the request's task only; project needs `until`.
